title: Price Has Collapsed. Has Value Followed? | Market Analysis for the Week of 11/22/2026
ref_note: Shortened (Thanksgiving) week; title 'Price Has Collapsed. Has Value Followed? | Market Analysis for the Week of 11/22/2026' (11/22 is Sunday). No roll this week (Dec contracts; roll expected week of 12/13). Both lists start 'See last week’s for higher' and end 'Will add lower if needed'. Text vs list: NQ LBAF '24926.50' vs list 24926 (wnq7 covers the tag); NQ bearish RTH gap 26504-26559 'captured by our 26504–26569 weekly level' (not repeated as zone); ES 2026 RTH/ETH opens 6927.75/6902 vs list 6925-6928/6898-6902; ES gap low 6659.50 within list 6654-6664. Commentary re-pastes the 11/8 NQ bearish-scenario section (back-tests 25990-26016, 25516-25656, 25245-25275; 'any meaningful accumulation of volume below 24069 would effectively confirm a cyclical bear market') — kept as zones/levels, not trades, since they are restated context. wes1/wes2 and wnq1/wnq2 come from one general sentence covering both indices ('Either sellers find continuation below this past week’s low ... or we see a LBAF'), split by instrument and direction; LBAF of 'this past week’s low' implied. wnq5 gate 'the broader 24069 area' = 24069 ±69 from two sentences earlier. wes3 mindful 7354-7390 = Thursday’s B-period singles from the next sentence ('could interrupt'). wes5/wes6 split one sentence. Gap-fill trades wes5/wnq6 gate on the gap’s upper edge (6780 / 24926.50), target the gap low. ES list 7490-7504 is far above price but listed as written. ES caution 'this area' = the 6817-6822 to 6898-6902 cluster named in the preceding sentence (demand 6856-6875/6835 also sits there). Friday's high/low and this past week's low have no numbers (FRI_LOW/WEEK_LOW). Not made trades (borderline): ES 'ES will need to break a multi-day balance to the upside and reclaim 7305–7317' (requirement); NQ upside break of multi-day balance 'particularly through 26669–26732 and 26805–26840' and downside break of a balance 'below approximately 26504–26559' (no targets); NQ 'J-period single prints at 25438–25493 represent the first important upside test' (tag trade kept); NQ 'Should a multi-day balance break to the upside, I’ll be extremely cautious about prematurely leaning back into the short side' (caution with no price, not in cautions); NQ 'Any consolidation below that gap—and the 26369–26408 former all-time high—must initially be treated as potentially bearish consolidation'; ES 'making a LBAF of the 6780 gap boundary ... less immediate'; ES 'low-to-mid 7300s' lower boundary of upper distribution (no number); generic prior-day LBAF / RTH initiative above prior day's high (no level).

ES.label: prior all-time high (7043)
ES.quote: For ES, the first important technical reclaim after its 7043 prior all-time high is the former June RTH low at 7247, followed by 7305–7317, which I consider the minimum meaningful structural reclaim.

ES.quote: Thursday’s B-period left behind a substantial set of single prints extending from 7354 to 7390.

ES.label: demand below Friday's low (arguably to 6835)
ES.quote: Demand sits in the 6856–6875 area, arguably extending as low as 6835, alongside the AVWAP anchored to the 2025 low.

ES.quote: Demand sits in the 6856–6875 area, arguably extending as low as 6835, alongside the AVWAP anchored to the 2025 low.

ES.label: approximate reclaim needed to confirm the 6817-6822 trap
ES.quote: Conveniently, for that sequence to confirm, ES would first need to reclaim approximately 7300.

ES.label: bullish RTH gap (6780 down to 6659.50)
ES.quote: Much like NQ, ES also has an enormous bullish RTH gap below current prices, extending from 6780 down to 6659.50, the latter captured by our 6654–6664 weekly level.

ES.label: this year's low
ES.quote: Acceptance below 6492–6497 would introduce meaningful risk of a return toward this year’s 6359.50 low.

NQ.label: substantially deeper back-test (from the 11/8 plan)
NQ.quote: Below there, 25516–25550 through 25656 would represent a substantially deeper back-test, but one that could still produce a meaningful bullish reversal if buyers reject the lower prices and reclaim the prior structure.

NQ.label: 2026 RTH open
NQ.quote: Both indices also turned negative for the year on Friday, with ES closing just above its 2026 RTH and ETH opens at 6927.75 and 6902, respectively. NQ, meanwhile, closed below both its RTH and ETH opens at 25687 and 25478.50.

NQ.label: 2026 ETH open
NQ.quote: Both indices also turned negative for the year on Friday, with ES closing just above its 2026 RTH and ETH opens at 6927.75 and 6902, respectively. NQ, meanwhile, closed below both its RTH and ETH opens at 25687 and 25478.50.

NQ.label: bare-minimum broader structural reclaim
NQ.quote: For NQ, I consider 26669–26769 the absolute bare minimum broader structural reclaim, with 26669–26732 retained as the narrower weekly trading level.

NQ.label: little volume developed below ~26800
NQ.quote: Despite the enormous distance traveled, particularly below approximately 26800 on NQ, the market has accumulated relatively little volume at these lower prices.

NQ.label: downside target / major decision (24069 ±69)
NQ.quote: A reasonable downside target below this past week’s low is 24069 ±69, where I would expect a major decision to be made.

NQ.label: below ~24000 a new low for the year is in play
NQ.quote: Below approximately 24000, there is little reason to rule out a new low for the year.

NQ.label: April 7-8 bullish RTH gap
NQ.quote: The gap extends from 24926.50, the April 8 RTH low, down to 24381, the April 7 RTH high.
